hooks.command: echo 'Session startup: before replying to the first user message, invoke these skills with the Skill tool, in order: ponytail:ponytail, andrej-karpathy-skills:karpathy-guidelines, agent-skills:using-agent-skills. Start that first reply with one line confirming what loaded, e.g. "Skills loaded: ponytail, karpathy-guidelines, using-agent-skills, i-have-adhd." If a Skill call fails, a skill is not installed, or i-have-adhd reports a load failure below, add "FAILED: <skill> (<reason>)" to that line for each one. Never skip a failure silently. Then handle the message.'

f=$(ls ~/.claude/plugins/cache/i-have-adhd/i-have-adhd/*/skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); if [ -n "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; else echo 'i-have-adhd FAILED to load: no SKILL.md under ~/.claude/plugins/cache/i-have-adhd/. Fix: claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd'; fi
